entries.mechanism: EUROMOD BE_2025 tinfe_be computes the refundable Article 289ter/1 low-wage work-bonus tax credit (tintcly_s) from the pre-cap scheduled i_tsceerdA_s and i_tsceerdB_s amounts, while CIR 92 Article 289ter/1 bases the credit on the work-bonus reductions actually granted, so the source-backed RuleSpec caps the A/B credit bases by the Article 38 personal contribution before reductions. At the 10k low-wage case EUROMOD returns the uncapped 1504.85 EUR ceiling while the granted-base RuleSpec returns 724.48 EUR; the 780.37 EUR gap is the uncapped-versus- granted base difference. The 30k and 45k cases sit above the low-wage band where the bases coincide and match within tolerance.

Same ec-jrc issue #12 mechanism as the 10k case: EUROMOD BE_2025 tinfe_be bases tintcly_s on the uncapped i_tsceerdA_s / i_tsceerdB_s schedule and returns the 1504.85 EUR ceiling, while the RuleSpec caps the A/B credit bases by the Article 38 personal contribution actually granted and returns 1014.27 EUR. The 490.57 EUR gap is the uncapped- versus-granted base difference at this still-low-wage point.
